gaps.sentence: We're trying to get rid ___ these old boxes.
gaps.explanation: get rid OF something = remove it.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
Please could you look ___ my plants while I'm away?

gaps.explanation: pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.

gaps.sentence: Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.
